name: Samuel Perez
office: City of Bell Gardens, Member of the City Council

items.text: Samuel Perez is the vice chair of Bell Gardens’ Traffic and Safety Commission. He graduated from California State University, Los Angeles with a degree in business administration and accounting, and works in auditing after previously working as an administrative specialist at the L.A. County Office of Education.

sentences.text: Samuel Perez is the vice chair of Bell Gardens’ Traffic and Safety Commission.

He graduated from California State University, Los Angeles with a degree in business administration and accounting, and works in auditing after previously working as an administrative specialist at the L.A. County Office of Education.

items.text: His stated priorities include public safety and economic development, and ensuring every decision contributes “to the city’s success.” He says he hopes to address the city’s parking congestion and budget deficit, and to promote financial transparency. In a 2024 candidate questionnaire, Perez supported expanding earthquake emergency plans and argued for a “balanced perspective” on rent caps, saying they could deter housing investment and construction.
